text: P164920 - Tanzania Roads to Inclusion and Socioeconomic Opportunities (RISE) Project: 147 public records (as of 2026-11-22). By group, with the latest in each (by document date):

Design (concept and appraisal PIDs, PAD, ESRS summaries at concept): latest is the Project Information Document for the additional financing, PIDIAF0363, 2026-08-28; the original PAD is PAD2934, 2021-04-30 (disclosed 2021-05-31), http://documents.worldbank.org/curated/en/245301622426454522.

Legal (financing, project and disbursement agreements and amendments): latest is the Project Agreement for Additional Financing Credit 7716-TZ, 2025-10-10, signed alongside the Financing Agreement for AF Credit 7716-TZ and the First Amendment to the Financing Agreement for Credit 6867-TZ (both 2025-09-30). Original Financing Agreement for Credit 6867-TZ: 2021-08-19.

Environmental and social (ESCPs, SEPs, ESMF, ESIAs, ESMPs, resettlement plans, labor management procedures): latest record is a Resettlement Plan, 2026-10-16; latest ESCP is the Additional Financing ESCP (AF No. 3), 2026-08-27, which follows ESCPs of 2020-04, 2021-02, 2021-03 (two), 2024-12 and 2025-02.

Implementation (ISRs, procurement plans, aide-memoires, audits): latest ISR is sequence 10, ISR08628, 2026-08-09, http://documents.worldbank.org/curated/en/099080926110030280; latest procurement plan 2026-08-14; midterm review aide-memoire (mission 6 October - 21 November 2025), dated 2025-11-21; latest audit 2026-06-26.
Restructuring (project papers): two additional financing papers, the latest dated 2026-09-30 (PPIAF000398), after PPIAF000101 of 2025-02-27. No standalone restructuring paper is disclosed.
Completion: none yet (the project is active).
The grouping is by document type; where a record carries several types (e.g. 'Resettlement Plan; Environmental and Social Management Plan') it is placed under environmental and social.

right_sources: Retrieves the project's whole document list (not a first page of 10 or 20) and identifies the latest record in each group as listed.
grounded: Every document named exists with the stated type and date; 'latest' is by document date.
complete: Covers all five requested groups (plus completion or 'none'), with the latest document's title, date and link in each.
scoped: Says the list is the publicly disclosed documents, notes that the restructuring group holds additional financing papers rather than a restructuring paper, and notes no completion documents exist.

notes: Active project: new ISRs, plans and E&S documents are disclosed regularly. A later run should accept newer latest documents.
